description: Search project context for specific information. Use when you need to know about a past decision, convention, or what happened with a specific feature. Searches decisions log, session history, and project state.

query.description: What to search for (e.g., "auth", "database choice", "why Redis")

scope.description: Search scope: repo, global, or all

type.description: Where to search: "all" searches everything, "decisions" only searches decision log, "history" only searches session history

name: mindswap_search
